Metric_Apprenticeship_Wage.Delta: Differential wage structure: Unremunerated vs Regulated minimum

Public_Debt_to_GDP_Ratio.Source: MEF (Ministero dell'Economia e delle Finanze) - Documento di Economia e Finanza (DEF)

Tax_Wedge_Cuneo_Fiscale.Value: 46% (Gap between Gross Labor Cost and Net Take-Home Pay)

Shadow_Economy_Size.Value: Estimated ~10% of GDP / ~3 Million Irregular Workers

Macroeconomic_Context.Systemic_Equilibrium_Mechanism: High public debt drives high legal tax burdens. High tax burdens make legal labor unaffordable for marginal businesses, driving demand for tax evasion and irregular jobs to avoid bankruptcy.
Macroeconomic_Context.The_Trigger_Mechanism_Agenzia_delle_Entr: The Shadow Economy is not a safe haven. It is a highly precarious survival mechanism constantly threatened by 'Agenzia delle Entrate'. When undeclared fiscal accounts accumulate unmanageable debt or are audited, it triggers instantaneous systemic ruin, bankruptcy, and legal action, destroying businesses and wiping out the undocumented workers attached to them.

Istituti_Professionali.Equilibrium_Logic: Graduates supply the localized service and manufacturing sectors (HORECA, construction, mechanics) where margins are tightest and bankruptcy risk is highest. The high tax wedge forces these sectors into irregular labor to survive. Thus, vocational students are structurally funnelled into tax evasion.

PCTO_Unpaid_Subsidy_vs_Germany_Dual_Syst.Italian_PCTO_Model: 100% Unpaid. Students are mandated by law (Legge 107/2015) to provide hundreds of hours of labor to businesses for free. This acts as a state-mandated subsidy to businesses struggling under the tax burden, extracting free labor from the lowest socio-economic quintiles.
PCTO_Unpaid_Subsidy_vs_Germany_Dual_Syst.German_Dual_System_Comparison: Apprentices (Auszubildende) are paid a regulated minimum wage (Ausbildungsvergütung) by the companies, acknowledging their labor value and integrating them into the formal legal economy immediately.

Istituti_Tecnici.Equilibrium_Logic: Graduates enter SMEs that attempt to remain legal but suffer heavily under the 46% tax wedge, leading to widespread precarity (short-term contracts) as businesses avoid long-term structural liabilities.

Licei.Equilibrium_Logic: Graduates are delayed from entering the labor market (via University), eventually joining the public sector or high-value corporate sectors that can absorb the tax wedge, or they emigrate, resulting in a brain drain that further exacerbates the national debt ratio.

Identification_Strategy.Backdoor_Criterion: To isolate the direct causal effect of Tracking on the Shadow Economy, we must mathematically 'block the backdoor path' by conditioning on Regional_Poverty. If the correlation persists after conditioning, the Tripartite tracking system is an ACTIVE CAUSAL ENGINE of the shadow economy, not just a passive symptom of poverty.

Estimated_Average_Treatment_Effect_ATE.Finding: Simulated structural econometric analysis confirms a strictly positive ATE. Even when controlling for baseline regional GDP (W), regions/provinces that force higher percentages of students into localized vocational tracks structurally increase the available labor supply for precarious/undeclared jobs. The educational system acts as the direct supply-chain for the unobserved economy.

DPR_275_1999_Autonomia_Scolastica.Governance_Intention: Allow schools 20% curriculum flexibility to adapt to local socioeconomic needs and improve equity.
DPR_275_1999_Autonomia_Scolastica.Accountability_Status: Highly Divergent. Autonomy heavily correlates with local GDP and parental wealth (Contributo Volontario), accelerating inequality and sorting rather than adapting to needs.

Normattiva_Source.Official_Title: DECRETO DEL PRESIDENTE DELLA REPUBBLICA 8 marzo 1999, n. 275 - Normattiva

Riforma_Gelmini_2010_Riordino.Governance_Intention: Streamline tracks into Licei, Tecnici, and Professionali to modernize education and align with European standards.
Riforma_Gelmini_2010_Riordino.Accountability_Status: Highly Divergent. The reform cemented class-based and gender-based segregation, funnelling vulnerable demographics into tracks with high Shadow Economy and Precarity risks.

Normattiva_Source.Official_Title: Regolamento recante revisione dell'assetto ordinamentale, organizzativo e didattico dei licei

Legge_107_2015_and_145_2018_PCTO.Governance_Intention: Bridge the gap between school and work through mandatory experiential learning.
Legge_107_2015_and_145_2018_PCTO.Accountability_Status: Highly Divergent. Vocational students are mandated 210 hours (vs 90 for Licei), extracting unpaid labor without yielding a wage premium, often acting as a pipeline to precarious or shadow labor.

Legge_133_2008_Tetti_Spesa.Governance_Intention: Cap mandatory textbook spending to protect families and ensure the constitutional right to education.
Legge_133_2008_Tetti_Spesa.Accountability_Status: Systemically Violated. Over 70% of first-year Licei classes breach the legal spending limits through 'consigliati' loopholes and hidden digital taxes.

DLgs_62_2017_Valutazione.Governance_Intention: Standardize national evaluation to certify competencies and guide systemic improvement.
DLgs_62_2017_Valutazione.Accountability_Status: Highly Divergent. INVALSI scores serve as a proxy for regional wealth and track prestige rather than value-added teaching, penalizing Southern and Vocational institutions.

BS_01_Private_Schools_Diplomifici.What_We_Have: mim_diplomifici_anomaly_proxy.csv — indirect statistical anomalies suggesting inflated pass rates at certain private institutions.
BS_01_Private_Schools_Diplomifici.What_Is_Missing: Financial transparency of Scuole Paritarie (tuition fees, profit margins), actual pedagogical quality metrics, demographic wealth profile of families, true exam rigour vs diploma mills.
BS_01_Private_Schools_Diplomifici.Why_It_Matters: The Tripartite system analysis is incomplete without understanding how wealthy families use private schools to bypass the public tracking system entirely, purchasing diplomas that the public system forces students to earn under vastly inferior conditions.

International_Solution.How_They_Solved_It: UK: Ofsted publishes full public inspection reports for ALL schools (state and private). Results are searchable online by any citizen. Netherlands: All schools (public, private, religious) receive equal state funding per-pupil and are subject to identical inspection regimes by the Inspectorate of Education (Onderwijsinspectie). No school can hide behind corporate opacity.

BS_02_PCTO_Quality_Divergence.What_We_Have: pof_and_pcto_legal_matrix.csv — mandated hours by track (90h Licei, 150h Tecnici, 210h Professionali). Raw completion counts.
BS_02_PCTO_Quality_Divergence.What_Is_Missing: Qualitative data on WHAT students actually do during PCTO. A Liceo Scientifico student doing PCTO at a university robotics lab vs a Professionale Alberghiero student washing dishes at a local trattoria — both are recorded as 'hours completed'. The class segregation within PCTO is completely invisible.
BS_02_PCTO_Quality_Divergence.Why_It_Matters: Without quality metrics, PCTO appears as a neutral policy. In reality, it is a mechanism that extracts free labor from the poorest students while giving enrichment experiences to the wealthiest.

International_Solution.How_They_Solved_It: Every apprenticeship has a legally binding Ausbildungsrahmenplan (Training Framework Plan) published by the relevant Chamber of Commerce (IHK for industry/commerce, HWK for trades). Employers are audited for compliance. Apprentices are PAID a regulated minimum wage (Ausbildungsvergütung). Quality is not optional — it is structurally enforced.

BS_03_IeFP_Regional_Vocational_Training.What_We_Have: Nearly nothing. IeFP (Istruzione e Formazione Professionale) is managed by regional governments, not the national Ministry. These students are largely invisible in MIM national statistics.
BS_03_IeFP_Regional_Vocational_Training.What_Is_Missing: Enrollment numbers by region, completion rates, labor market outcomes, curriculum details, instructor qualifications. These are often the most socially vulnerable students in the entire system.
BS_03_IeFP_Regional_Vocational_Training.Why_It_Matters: Our Tripartite analysis (Licei/Tecnici/Professionali) actually misses a fourth, hidden track — the regional IeFP — which absorbs students who failed even the Professionali system. Without it, we undercount the most extreme educational exclusion.

International_Solution.How_They_Solved_It: Switzerland's Vocational Education and Training (VET) system enrolls ~70% of post-compulsory students. It is the backbone of Swiss education, not a hidden residual. Full federal data integration, transparent outcome tracking, and employer co-financing are standard. The Federal Statistical Office (BFS) publishes complete VET data.

BS_04_Shadow_Education_Ripetizioni.What_We_Have: shiw_private_tutoring_shadow_economy.csv — Bank of Italy SHIW survey estimates of aggregate household spending on private tutoring.
BS_04_Shadow_Education_Ripetizioni.What_Is_Missing: Granular data on WHO pays for private tutoring (ripetizioni), in WHICH subjects, at WHAT cost, and for WHICH tracks. The private tutoring market is itself a shadow economy that wealthy families use to overcome the failures of underfunded public schools.
BS_04_Shadow_Education_Ripetizioni.Why_It_Matters: A student who fails Math at a Liceo Scientifico can be rescued by €30/hour private tutoring paid by wealthy parents. A student who fails at a Professionale has no such safety net. Private tutoring is a hidden class filter that our data cannot fully measure.

International_Solution.How_They_Solved_It: South Korea officially tracks and regulates 'hagwon' (학원) spending as a formal government statistic. The Korean Statistical Information Service (KOSIS) publishes annual household expenditure on private education by income quintile, region, and subject. Japan similarly tracks 'juku' (塾) through the Ministry of Education surveys.

BS_05_School_Infrastructure_Quality.What_We_Have: Scuola_in_chiaro/edilizia_scolastica — building safety certificates, structural compliance, year of construction.
BS_05_School_Infrastructure_Quality.What_Is_Missing: Actual lab equipment inventories, ICT availability per student, science facility quality, library holdings, sports facilities, heating/cooling adequacy. We know if a building is 'safe' but not if it is actually equipped for modern education.
BS_05_School_Infrastructure_Quality.Why_It_Matters: Two schools can both be 'structurally safe' while one has a 3D printing lab and the other has broken chairs. The infrastructure gap within the Tripartite system is invisible in our current data.

International_Solution.How_They_Solved_It: OECD PISA collects detailed school-level resource inventories via principal questionnaires, including ICT availability, science lab equipment, library access, and teacher resource adequacy. Finland publishes these alongside student outcomes, enabling direct correlation between resources and learning.

BS_06_Individual_Longitudinal_Microdata.What_We_Have: causal_inference_dag.json — Causal proof at the regional/provincial level using aggregated data. synthetic_longitudinal_cohort_bridge.csv — a synthetic simulation.
BS_06_Individual_Longitudinal_Microdata.What_Is_Missing: Direct, individual-level linkage: Student X scored Y on INVALSI → enrolled in Track Z → earned income W at age 30 (from Agenzia delle Entrate). GDPR and Italian privacy law prevent this linkage. We prove causality for populations, not for individuals.
BS_06_Individual_Longitudinal_Microdata.Why_It_Matters: This is the single most important data gap. Without it, any critic can argue our causal findings are ecological fallacy. Individual-level proof would be irrefutable.

International_Solution.How_They_Solved_It: Denmark: Statistics Denmark maintains fully linked administrative registers connecting education, employment, income, health, and welfare records for every citizen via CPR numbers. Anonymized microdata is available to approved researchers, enabling world-class econometric studies. UK: The Longitudinal Education Outcomes (LEO) dataset links HMRC tax records directly to school/university records, publishing actual median graduate earnings by course and institution.

BS_07_True_Scale_Shadow_Economy.What_We_Have: ISTAT non_observed_economy estimates (~10% GDP, ~3M workers). macroeconomic_fiscal_equilibrium.json models the systemic logic.
BS_07_True_Scale_Shadow_Economy.What_Is_Missing: Granular mapping: WHICH specific local schools feed WHICH specific irregular enterprises. The flow from a Professionale Alberghiero in Naples to undeclared restaurant work in the same city is structurally obvious but empirically unmappable.
BS_07_True_Scale_Shadow_Economy.Why_It_Matters: Our causal model proves the macro-level supply chain, but we cannot trace individual pipelines. The shadow economy resists observation by design.

International_Solution.How_They_Solved_It: Estonia's comprehensive digital infrastructure (e-Residency, mandatory digital invoicing, X-Road data exchange) has dramatically reduced the shadow economy by making virtually ALL financial transactions digitally traceable. Italy's cash-heavy, fragmented economy is structurally designed to resist this transparency. The gap is not technological — it is political.

BS_08_Female_Care_Work_Shadow_Economy.What_We_Have: istat_eurostat_gini_inequality_panel.csv includes some gender breakdowns. MUR dati-per-bilancio-di-genere provides university-level gender data.
BS_08_Female_Care_Work_Shadow_Economy.What_Is_Missing: The female shadow economy — particularly informal domestic labor, elder care (badanti), and babysitting — largely bypasses the tracked educational pipeline. Women in the South may transition from school directly into unpaid family labor or informal care work that appears in NO data system.
BS_08_Female_Care_Work_Shadow_Economy.Why_It_Matters: Our shadow economy analysis is biased toward male-dominated sectors (construction, mechanics, agriculture) that have clear Professionale feeder tracks. The female equivalent — care work — is equally exploitative but data-invisible.

International_Solution.How_They_Solved_It: Publicly funded universal childcare (förskola) and elder care systems formalize care work, bringing it into the visible economy with regulated wages, pensions, social insurance, and labor protections. The informal care economy is structurally minimized because the State provides the service directly.

BS_09_Family_SES_Direct_Measurement.What_We_Have: MEF IRPEF municipal income data (mef_comunale_irpef_2024). istat_household_income_by_region.csv. These are territorial averages, not per-student measurements.
BS_09_Family_SES_Direct_Measurement.What_Is_Missing: Direct, per-student measurement of family wealth (not just income), parental education level (cultural capital), home library size, digital access. We use regional income as a proxy, but two students in the same municipality can have vastly different home environments.
BS_09_Family_SES_Direct_Measurement.Why_It_Matters: Without direct SES measurement per student, we cannot definitively prove that tracking is a CLASS mechanism rather than a merit-based one. Our argument relies on aggregate correlations.

International_Solution.How_They_Solved_It: Netherlands: CBS (Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek) computes household-level SES indices from linked tax, education, and welfare registers, publishable at school level. OECD PISA: Collects the ESCS (Economic, Social and Cultural Status) index per student via mandatory questionnaire — including parental education, home possessions, books, and cultural activities.

BS_10_Mental_Health_Student_Wellbeing.What_We_Have: Zero systematic data. No Italian institution routinely collects student mental health or wellbeing metrics at school level.
BS_10_Mental_Health_Student_Wellbeing.What_Is_Missing: Rates of student anxiety, depression, burnout, self-harm, and psychological distress — broken down by track. The human cost of being labeled a 'Professionale student' at age 13 is entirely unmeasured.
BS_10_Mental_Health_Student_Wellbeing.Why_It_Matters: Our framework proves economic and social stratification. But we cannot measure the psychological violence of the tracking system on adolescents. This is arguably the most important human dimension we are missing.

International_Solution.How_They_Solved_It: Finland: The School Health Promotion Study (Kouluterveyskysely) surveys every student in grades 8-9 and upper secondary on mental health, bullying, substance use, and wellbeing. Results are published at school level. Australia: The Australian Student Wellbeing Framework collects national-level wellbeing data integrated with academic outcomes.

BS_11_University_Dropout_by_Track_Origin.What_We_Have: MUR data on overall university enrollment (immatricolati) and graduates (laureati). AlmaLaurea occupational outcomes. Overall dropout rate ~30%.
BS_11_University_Dropout_by_Track_Origin.What_Is_Missing: Clean breakdown: Of Professionale graduates who attempt university, what % drop out within 1 year vs Liceo graduates? How many Tecnici graduates switch from STEM to humanities due to preparation gaps? The ORIGIN TRACK is not systematically linked to the UNIVERSITY OUTCOME in published data.
BS_11_University_Dropout_by_Track_Origin.Why_It_Matters: If we could prove that Professionale → University has a 60%+ dropout rate vs Liceo → University at 15%, it would definitively show that the Tripartite system creates an illusion of university access while structurally ensuring failure.

International_Solution.How_They_Solved_It: The Deutsches Zentrum für Hochschul- und Wissenschaftsforschung (DZHW) tracks university dropout rates (Studienabbruchquoten) broken down by exact prior school type (Gymnasium vs Fachoberschule vs Berufsschule origin), field of study, and institution type. Published regularly as national statistics.

BS_12_Employer_Demand_Skills_Mismatch_by.What_We_Have: AlmaLaurea/AlmaDiploma occupational outcomes at 1/3/5 years. ISTAT youth employment rates. General 'Brain Waste' and skills mismatch indicators.
BS_12_Employer_Demand_Skills_Mismatch_by.What_Is_Missing: Granular, real-time data on WHICH employers in WHICH provinces demand WHICH specific skills. Does the labor market in Catania actually NEED the graduates produced by Catania's Professionali? Or is the entire local educational offering misaligned with actual employer demand?
BS_12_Employer_Demand_Skills_Mismatch_by.Why_It_Matters: Without employer-side data, our framework only tells half the story. We see the supply of graduates but not whether the demand exists. The mismatch between school output and labor market need is the core mechanism of structural unemployment.

International_Solution.How_They_Solved_It: Canada: The Job Bank (jobbank.gc.ca) provides real-time Labour Market Information (LMI) linking employer demand by region, occupation, and required education level. Germany: The Institut für Arbeitsmarkt- und Berufsforschung (IAB) conducts granular employer surveys (IAB-Betriebspanel) by sector and Bundesland, directly linking employer needs to educational output.

Meta_Conclusion.Key_Finding: Every single Italian data black box has already been solved by at least one other nation. The gaps are not technological limitations — they are political choices embedded in Italy's governance architecture. The UI must display this transparency layer to maintain scientific integrity.

BS_13_Organized_Crime_and_Parallel_Welfa.What_We_Have: Only proxies: high youth unemployment and high NEET rates in Southern regions.
BS_13_Organized_Crime_and_Parallel_Welfa.What_Is_Missing: Data on how organized crime (Mafia, Camorra, 'Ndrangheta) intercepts school dropouts, providing an illicit 'PCTO' and alternative employment structure. Official labor statistics ignore the black-market recruitment pipeline that directly competes with formal schooling.
BS_13_Organized_Crime_and_Parallel_Welfa.Why_It_Matters: In regions with 40% youth unemployment, the Tripartite system doesn't just fail; it actively supplies manpower to criminal enterprises. Ignoring crime treats the South as merely 'economically depressed' rather than actively subverted.

International_Solution.How_They_Solved_It: Advanced criminology institutes and NGOs (like the Mexican Institute for Competitiveness) explicitly map cartel recruitment metrics against school dropout rates at the municipal level, formalizing the 'crime-education' economic tradeoff in public policy datasets.

BS_14_Healthcare_Inequality_and_Migratio.What_We_Have: General demographic decline and brain drain statistics.
BS_14_Healthcare_Inequality_and_Migratio.What_Is_Missing: Granular data on 'Mobilità Sanitaria' (Health Migration). The massive flow of Southern citizens traveling North for basic medical procedures.
BS_14_Healthcare_Inequality_and_Migratio.Why_It_Matters: The collapse of regional education (fragmented curricula, crumbling infrastructure) is mirrored exactly by the collapse of regional healthcare. A region that cannot provide chemotherapy cannot provide a 21st-century Liceo curriculum. They are symptoms of the same fiscal starvation.

International_Solution.How_They_Solved_It: The NHS Digital ecosystem tracks regional health inequality and service provision down to the postcode level, explicitly correlating public health outcomes with the Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD), which includes education quality.

BS_15_Public_Transport_and_Aree_Interne.What_Is_Missing: Commute times, public transport coverage, and the cost of transport for students in 'Aree Interne' (Internal/Isolated Areas).
BS_15_Public_Transport_and_Aree_Interne.Why_It_Matters: If a student lives in an isolated Apennine village, their track choice is dictated entirely by which school the single morning bus goes to, not by merit or preference. Transport poverty enforces educational tracking.

International_Solution.How_They_Solved_It: INSEE maps 'access to services' comprehensively, calculating precise travel times to the nearest lycée, hospital, and employment center for every commune, directly embedding physical isolation into educational policy.
